_readme: One scene per loyalty tier (1-5). Tier 1 plays on first hire. Each Fold moves every hired manager up 1 tier; the next tier's scene plays when you hire them again. Beat = [speaker, text, expression]. Speaker: m = manager (small box), c = Cadavire (main box), p = player (shown on the reply button). Expression only matters for c. 'rehire' plays after tier 5 is done. Motive is shown to the player only at tier 5.

tiers: H-hi! Soup Ghoul. I stir. I ladle. I have a hairnet. It's on my skull, but it counts.
He's cute. In a soup way. Hire him.
I won't let you down! The broth will be so hot. For you. For the customers! Customers.
So the stand got shut down? They said 'health code.' I said 'what health.' Nobody laughed.
Everything's gone. Except the bones. Bones aren't money, so they can't take them.
YES. I mean. Yes. Professionally. I kept my hairnet warm.
Third stand. Third shutdown. Third time you came back for me.
For the SOUP. They came back for the soup.
I know. You keep saying it. I wrote it on my ladle.
Can I say something? You're really good at ruining things. Beautifully. I'd follow you into any health violation.
Okay! That's enough stirring for one day.
Yes, boss. Anything, boss. Sorry. Hehe.
Full honesty: I don't care about the bones. I never did. I came back five times for you.
...Oh. Huh. Wow. The bones care though. I'm the bones. Rude.
Then stir like you mean it.
rehire: Back again! I kept the hairnet warm. I always do.

tiers: I am the Tone-Deaf Lich. I have taught music for four hundred years. No student has survived a lesson.
I can keep ALL time. Hire me and the xylophones will never stop.
The academy burned. Arson? No. Applause. Very hot applause.
Gone, gone, gone. But the bones are fine. Bones aren't money.
Interesting. You lose everything and keep the instruments. I respect a phylactery move.
You hide your fortune in the one thing they cannot seize. Clever. Musical, even.
He's taking notes. Why is he taking notes?
Of course. I would never study you. Ha. Ha. In C minor.
Tell me, boss. When the next collapse comes, who holds the bones? Hypothetically.
Me. I hold the bones. I am mostly bones.
Five collapses. I have memorized the whole score. One day this business will play for ME.
Ooh, a rival! Finally! I'm going to bite his metronome.
Oh, I will. After this lesson. Loyalty is just a long rest before the finale.
rehire: Back to the lessons. The finale can wait. For now.

tiers: Hank. Hydraulics. I crush what you point at. Time and a half on weekends.
He has a femur tattoo on his forearm. Hire him immediately.
Good. Clock's running. Crush, crush, paycheck.
Boss, the bank froze payroll. Froze it solid. Where's my check?
The money's gone. The bones aren't. Bones aren't money!
...Bones. Fine. Bones are heavy. Heavy is worth something.
Third shutdown. I'm starting to think you do it on purpose.
We don't. Mostly. Seventy percent accidents.
Now we're talking. A raise in what? Don't say bones. ...It's bones.
I did the math. Every time it falls apart, the bones pile up somewhere. I want a percentage.
He did math. With his hands. I'm impressed and scared.
Ten. And dental. My jaw clicks.
Real talk: I'm in. Not for you. Not for her. For the pile. Somebody's gotta crush it, and I like the overtime.
An honest man! Gross! I love it.
rehire: Clock's running, boss. Same rate. Ten percent.

tiers: Woof. I mean: Very Good Boy, Certified Public Accountant. I can bury anything. Receipts. Bones. Evidence.
A dog. A DOG. Who's a good accountant? You are!
I can balance a treat on my nose for nine minutes. Books are easier.
The park got audited. The auditors found holes. So many holes. I dug them. Sorry.
Doesn't matter! The bones are safe. Bones aren't money.
I AM?? Okay. Okay okay okay. Back to work. Tail is going.
Boss, small issue. Every time she walks by, I want to bury her.
I know. She's perfect. Very professional of me to notice.
I made her a spreadsheet. It's just her name. Highlighted. In every cell.
That's... okay, that's kind of sweet. Don't tell anyone I said that.
Honest truth, partner. I stay for the bones. One very specific collection of bones. She is standing right there.
I'm flattered! And concerned! Mostly flattered! Do NOT bury me.
Good boy. Back to the park.
Best job. Best boss. Best bones.
rehire: Woof! Back! Is she here? She's here. Woof.

tiers: Forge Mummy. I smelt. I cast. I do not unwrap. Don't ask.
Mysterious. I like her. I don't trust her. I like her.
Three pharaohs. All deceased. Very satisfied.
The foundry collapsed. The floor went. Funny. I filed the report before it happened.
Before? Huh. Anyway. Bones aren't money!
Back to the forge. I'll keep... records.
A question for the file. Why do the bones always survive?
...My scrapbook. I scrapbook. Hire me again.
A wrap came loose. You saw nothing. Especially not a badge.
That was a BADGE. She has a badge! Shiny!
I am a mummy. Who audits. Part time. Let me keep the job.
Fine. I was sent to shut you down. Five times I did. Five times you came back with the bones. They can't touch bones.
So you're... on our side now?
Because this is the best paperwork I have ever seen. I'm unwrapping my loyalty. Only that. Nothing else.
rehire: Back on the books. Off the record.

tiers: Bubbles Moretti. I run a clean car wash. Very clean. Nobody's ever seen a car.
He talks with his hands. His hands are bones. Click click.
Soap, hoses, and nobody asking questions. You and me? We're gonna be friends.
Somebody talked. The feds came in with buckets. Took every dollar. Left the bones. Bones aren't money, capisce?
That's the spirit. You got guts, kid. Or you had them once.
Three raids. Three times you kept the goods. I'm startin' to admire the operation.
Admire it from over there, please.
Sure it is. For now. I'm kidding! Bubbles kids.
Hypothetical. Somebody wants to take over this little empire. Who stops him?
Ha! I like her. I like her a lot. Keep washin'.
Five washes, five fortunes in bones. I want the whole graveyard, kid. One day I take it from you. Nothing personal.
A villain! A real one! I'm guarding the bones now. And you. The bones, mostly.
Already in line. Front of it. Wash is open.
rehire: Wash is open, kid. For now.

tiers: Hiii besties! Influencer Wraith. Haunting your feed since 1892. Let's monetize the macabre!
She's so shiny. Is she a ghost or a ring light?
I can sell shirts to people with no torsos. Watch me.
So the brand got cancelled? Like, legally? The money's frozen but the bones are fine? Bones aren't money? Iconic.
A comeback arc. My favorite genre. Hit like if you've died.
Third collapse, third relaunch. The algorithm loves you. Do you love the algorithm?
I love bones. The algorithm is fine.
Selling. Also filming. Can she do a bite on camera?
Real talk: the sponsor money from YOUR downfall videos? Insane. I need a bigger cut.
She's selling our failures? ...That's actually smart.
Twenty. And a collab with her.
Okay, unfiltered: I'm here for the bag. You crash, I post, I profit. Five crashes, five viral moments. Never leaving.
Dr. Pith. Marrow science. I extract, I refine, and sometimes I weep with joy.
Of marrow. It's not a real degree. I built the university myself.
Fascinating. The company dissolved, but your bones remain. Because bones aren't money.
He gets it right away! Finally!
Yes. Note: subject returns after collapse. Subject seems... happy.
Third observation. Every collapse, you come back. Every time, she is waiting.
I'm not WAITING. I'm standing. Near the door. Different thing.
I've run the numbers. There is no rational reason to stay with this business.
Final results. Five collapses. Zero logic. Maximum joy. Conclusion: I simply like it here.
That's it? That's the big reveal?
Peer reviewed by me. I'm staying. Pass the marrow.
The Accountant. Deceased. Former bank. Current bank. Island-based. Shark-adjacent.
The island bank was seized. Every account. Every coin. They could not seize the bones. Bones aren't money. I checked the statute.
He checked the statute! I love paperwork guys!
They say you can't take it with you. I am dead. I am testing that. So far: inconclusive.
I have quietly moved one percent of all bones into an account named 'Definitely Not Mine.'
...I like you. Two percent it is.
Final ledger: I'm in for the money. Only the money. Even dead, I want more. That is why I'm good at this.
Honest! Dead! Greedy! A triple threat!
rehire: Ledger reopened. Two percent, as agreed.

tiers: Chief Containment Ghoul. I contain things. Radiation. Rumors. You, if needed.
He's big. Hire him. Stand behind me, though.
Don't ask what the coolant is.
Meltdown. Total. The money melted. The bones didn't. Bones aren't money. Bones are dense.
Dense bones are the best bones.
Rebuilding. Containing my curiosity about how you keep surviving.
Every meltdown makes you stronger. That isn't physics. That's a threat.
Is it a threat? I want it to be a threat.
Business is a reactor. One day someone pulls the rods.
I hold the keys to the core. The whole empire runs on my reactor. Think about that.
I am thinking about that. I'm thinking about biting you.
I don't get ideas. I contain them. For now.
Five meltdowns. I watched you keep every bone. Next time it falls apart, I won't rebuild for you. I'll take it.
Okay, final boss energy. I'm into it. As a business threat. Strictly.
Then I'll see you at the core.
Containment breach scheduled. Loyalty five. Watch your back.
rehire: Core is stable. For you. Today.
